study type: Experimental laboratory study using human tissue samples
exposure: Gestational age at delivery (preterm vs. term)
outcome: Permeability of amniochorion to calcium ions
cohort: Human amniochorion tissue samples obtained directly after cesarean section from patients delivering at term and prematurely.
finding: Transmembrane transport and permeability of calcium ions were lower in preterm amniochorion tissue samples compared to term tissue samples, especially in the first 60 minutes of experiments.
